quarterly_data.quarter: Rolls-Royce press release: Rolls-Royce to elevate EU's latest Clean Aviation call (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Rolls-Royce was selected by the European Union's Clean Aviation programme to lead the ELEVATED project (a Rolls-Royce Deutschland-led consortium), to demonstrate a hybrid-electric gas-turbine propulsion system for future short- to medium-range aircraft; subject to successful completion of grant preparation, it will embed a hybrid-electric subsystem into a donor engine and assess its impact on the UltraFan 30 narrowbody technology demonstrator, which is planned for ground testing in 2028. The 19 Clean Aviation Call 4 projects will receive up to EUR 290 million in EU funding in total (Rolls-Royce's share is not stated); Rolls-Royce also participates in the FARMAN and H-ELENA projects.
